open_issues.text: vitest and eslint cannot start in this sandbox: reads of node_modules/**/*.min.js are denied (EACCES). Only `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` ran (exit 0, also type-checks the new tests). The new vitest tests were reviewed by reading but not executed.

Edited packages/gui/frontend/src/components/CommandRunner.tsx (not in the write set): an optional `context` prop so commands of plan/item scope get plan_id/item_id; without it the actions of the plan pages (grant, item-reopen, log-note, decision-decide) would be refused by the host.

open_issues.impact: none for the user; the body of a query carries the ids twice
open_issues.text: Path params plan_id/item_id/run_id go to `context` AND stay in `params` (guidance said to move them): the gui-planner queries declare plan_id/item_id as required params, so the host rejects a query without them.

For P4.5: the schema-form route does not exist yet in gui.json of the bridge; QueryView/ContributionRoute already give `context.plan_id/item_id` and `routeContext()` is exported from components/QueryView.tsx for reuse. ViewDataView still shows a placeholder for schema-form. The item resource-detail passes `onAction`, which opens CommandRunner with the page context.
Board link params carry plan_id (and item_id) only; the phase filter of the board is a query param, so the phases list opens the whole board (as noted in P4.2).

open_issues.impact: the commit takes these paths with the piece; the reviewer saw them

summary: Added host views BoardView, DependencyGraphView (plain SVG plus a dependencies table) and ResourceDetailView, wired them in ViewDataView, added an accessible label to progress cells, and made the plan/item/run ids of a route path go into the query context (QueryView.routeContext, path params also stay in params because the query declares them). ContributionRoute reports a plan or item page without its ids and passes the context to page actions; CommandRunner/CommandForm gained an optional context. Tests, docs/frontend.md and CHANGELOG updated. tsc --noEmit passes; vitest and eslint could not run in this sandbox.
